description: This PHP class 'WorkShiftDao' is a Data Access Object responsible for managing database operations related to 'WorkShift' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, update, and delete work shift records and associated employee shift data.

classes.name: WorkShiftDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for dealing with 'WorkShift' data in the database, including CRUD operations and employee shift associations.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieve a WorkShift entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingWorkShiftIds
methods.description: Fetch existing WorkShift IDs from the database matching provided list.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of WorkShift entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftListPaginator
methods.description: Get a Paginator object for paginated retrieval of WorkShift entities based on filters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Count the number of WorkShifts matching search filters.

methods.name: saveWorkShift
methods.description: Persist a new WorkShift entity, optionally saving associated employee shifts within a transaction.

methods.name: updateWorkShift
methods.description: Update an existing WorkShift and its associated employee shifts.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Create EmployeeWorkShift records for given employees linked to a specific shift.

methods.name: getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieve all Employee entities assigned to a specific shift.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployees
methods.description: Remove EmployeeWorkShift records for specific employees associated with a shift.

methods.name: deleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Delete WorkShift records for given IDs.
